network_access.method: Inherited proxy and CA trust retained. git ls-remote for the pin; curl with TLS verification enabled, HTTPS-only redirect/protocol limits and bounded30s per download. Additional sandbox network access used; no policy bypass, credential inspection, paid service, dependency installation or proxy override.

integration_risks_and_constraints: Native readability has NOT been tested at16px or any other size. The source is a candidate only. Use at least16px; evaluate18–20px for actual short notes before selecting a size/weight.

U+2192 RIGHTWARDS ARROW and U+2713 CHECK MARK are absent. Keep printed deltas, receipts totals and choice ticks in the existing clear font. If narrative copy contains these glyphs, preserve copy and provide a verified explicit fallback; do not silently change punctuation.
A variable font requires actual Godot import and native weight/shaping proof. Do not assume native400,500 or600 produces the desired result from source metadata alone.

Apply a handwritten face to intended narrative notes only. Existing InkNote member reactions in rehearsal_press.gd override16px default to14px outside tall-tablet mode and must be included in a future scoped font-floor fix.
Clear-font option must restore the existing inherited native font for notes without changing saved authored copy or gameplay. The current app has no clear-font setting.
Preserve the existing original RGBA printed wordmark and all controls/numeric tables/meters/cast/hardware. The wordmark is artwork, not this font.
caveat.next_action: Root decides whether to include the source in a fresh scoped S51 preflight and native pilot after focused core validation. No source promotion is performed by this intake.
